## Professional Summary
Senior Design Engineer and Technology Director with deep experience across full-stack engineering, interface architecture, and product strategy. Proven track record architecting and deploying end-to-end B2B platforms, SaaS products, and distributed web applications with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase. Adept at translating complex commercial requirements into resilient technical blueprints, data schemas, and clean, modular systems under 150 lines per module. Strong background leading cross-functional teams, driving product delivery from concept to production, and maintaining rigorous security and design standards.
